Do you swallow spiders in your sleep? Myth check.
A spider expert at the Burke Museum (University of Washington) says no case is on formal record, and a sleeper's vibrations tend to warn spiders away. An expert's view, not a study.

items.caption:
Why can't you move when you wake up?
It's sleep paralysis: in REM sleep your muscles are switched off, and sometimes the mind wakes first. About 8% of people have had it. If it's frequent or worrying, talk to a doctor.
Have you ever felt someone there?

items.caption:
Why do you twitch as you fall asleep?
It's a hypnic jerk, or sleep start. 60 to 70% of people report them, sometimes with a feeling of falling, and they're often not remembered (AASM).
When you jolt awake, does it feel like falling?

items.caption:
Why do I wake up at 3am? What sleep science says.
Brief wake-ups are normal, 3 to 4 a.m. is a body-clock turning point, and a 2022 hypothesis says night tilts mood negative. If it keeps costing you sleep, talk to a doctor.

items.caption:
Why do you hear a bang as you fall asleep?
It's exploding head syndrome: a sudden loud noise in your head as you drift off or wake. It's usually painless, and 18% of 211 US college students said they had it at least once. If it's frequent or worrying, talk to a doctor.
Have you ever heard the bang?

items.caption:
Do you dream in color?
In one diary study of 60 people, about 4% of under-25s' dreams were black and white, vs about a quarter for over-55s raised on black-and-white TV. Small study: a link, not proof.
What color do you remember from your last dream?

items.caption:
How long should it take to fall asleep? About 10 to 20 minutes.
Dropping off almost instantly, night after night, can be a sign of sleep debt. Fine if you wake refreshed; if you are tired every day, talk to a doctor.

items.caption:
Dreaming your teeth are falling out?
In one study of 210 students, teeth dreams weren't linked to distress or poor sleep, but went with tension in the teeth, gums or jaw on waking. Linked, not proven.
Teeth, falling, or being chased: which one comes back for you?
